groups.definition: New or higher tariffs on imported vehicles, parts and materials and changes to trade agreements raise costs that mitigation may not fully offset.
Violations of or changes in export controls, sanctions, foreign investment rules and anti-corruption laws could result in penalties and restrictions on business.
Large customers may curtail purchases due to sourcing policy changes, tariffs, export controls or other trade measures.

groups.canonical_name: Combined tariffs and export controls disruption
groups.definition: New or increased US and China tariffs, export controls and sanctions could disrupt trade and harm sales and operations.
